description: Change a watch's webhook URLs, sensitivity or subscribed events. New URLs are tested first; failures leave the old config untouched.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to (default all). Omit to keep current events.

secret.description: The one-time bearer secret returned by x402_watch_create.

slack_url.description: Replace Slack/Discord URL(s). Single string or array; max 5. Omit to keep current URL(s).

webhook_url.description: Replace webhook URL(s). Single string or array; max 5. Omit to keep current webhook(s).

name: x402_watch_edit
title: x402 Trust watch: edit delivery URLs, sensitivity or events
